# cidaas_hosted_page_group (Resource)

Manages a hosted page group via `POST/GET/DELETE /hostedpages-srv/hpgroup` for **cidaas v4.x** (Trustdesk) tenants.

> **Note for v3.x Tenants:** For cidaas v3.x, use **[`cidaas_hosted_page`](hosted_page.md)** instead.

Requires:
- `cidaas:hosted_pages_write`
- `cidaas:hosted_pages_read`
- `cidaas:hosted_pages_delete`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cidaas_hosted_page_group" "example" {
  name           = "external-customer-group"
  default_locale = "en"
  group_owner    = "client"

  hosted_pages = [
    {
      hosted_page_id = "login"
      locale         = "en"
      url            = "https://example.com/login"
    },
    {
      hosted_page_id = "register"
      locale         = "en"
      url            = "https://example.com/register"
    }
  ]
}
```
